events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $8.22 (model confidence 0.83)
events.body:
RydeTAXI is metered, so off-route km feed directly into the fare; the trace confirms two off-route segments exist on this trip [F3][F4] and RD-1 applies with no percentage or km threshold. Each segment must therefore be screened against RD-3, RD-4 and RD-5.

RD-4 does not excuse either segment. Both replaced stretches were motorway/airport corridors and the record shows no incident on the optimal route during the trip window [F13]; the speed bands at 30–39 km/h on East Coast Parkway and Airport Boulevard [F11][F12] are better than the band 1–2 congestion definition and, in any case, band evidence alone cannot exempt a segment under RD-4(b) [F13].

RD-3 does not apply. The complete chat record contains no rider message at all, so no rider ever named a place or requested a stop [F9]; the driver's post-trip assertion that "the GPS rerouted me" is a statement, not a rider-named stop or a rider request [F10].

RD-5 fails for both segments. Consent must be a rider message sent before the segment starts, and there is no rider message before 22:56 or before 23:08 [F9]; a driver's account of rerouting given after the trip cannot establish consent, and an unrecorded/verbal agreement is not consent [F10]. With no rider message at all, the ground for both segments is consent_after_or_none, and they count as non-exempt detours under RD-2.

Amount: only the mileage units of the non-exempt segments are refundable, at this trip's rate of distance fare ÷ distance km = $39.42 ÷ 27.96 km = $1.4099/km [F5][F8]. Segment F3 adds 2.46 km and segment F4 adds 3.37 km [F3][F4], total 5.83 km × $1.4099/km = $8.2206, i.e. $8.22 [RD-2]. The remaining excess-distance gap (billed 6.49 km vs 5.83 km attributed to segments) is corridor/matching noise and is not refunded [F5][RD-2]. The metered waiting charge of $0.02 is a meter unit on RydeTAXI and is not refundable [F6][RD-3(c)].

No account flag: the driver's profile shows one dispute in 90 days with zero upheld, so route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 and RD-6's "repeated breach" condition is not met [F16]; the profile facts are used only for this ancillary question and never as a basis for the deviation finding itself [F15].

Safety screen: I read the rider's complaint, the only chat line, and the driver's statement [F9][F10]. The complaint is a fare/routing grievance and the driver's reply is a flat denial of wrongdoing; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so the screen is none [SAFE-1].
